english.title: Contravene restriction on training for dangerous performances by persons under 12 years of age
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[caused a child under the age of 12 years, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to be trained to take part in performances of a dangerous nature]_
(B)_[caused a child who had attained the age of 12 years, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..),to be trained to take part in performances of a dangerous nature other than under and in accordance with the terms of a licence granted and in force under section 24 of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933]_
(C)_[procured a child under the age of 12 years, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),to be trained to take part in performances of a dangerous nature]_
(D)_[procured a child who had attained the age of 12 years, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..), to be trained to take part in performances of a dangerous nature other than under and in accordance with the terms of a licence granted and in force under section 24 of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933]_
(E)_[, being the parent or guardian of a child under the age of 12 years, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), allowed him to be trained to take part in performances of a dangerous nature]_
(F)_[, being the parent or guardian of a child under the age of 12 years, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), allowed her to be trained to take part in performances of a dangerous nature]_
(G)_[, being the parent or guardian of a child who had attained the age of 12 years, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..), allowed him to be trained to take part in performances of a dangerous nature other than under and in accordance with the terms of a licence granted and in force under section 24 of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933]_
(H)_[, being the parent or guardian of a child who had attained the age of 12 years, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..), allowed her to be trained to take part in performances of a dangerous nature other than under and in accordance with the terms of a licence granted and in force under section 24 of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 24 of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933.

date and location
cause / procure a child under 12 OR
